annotations.title: UK refund rights for a purchase

description: The UK consumer rights that apply to something bought (faulty, not arrived, poor service or a change of mind), strongest first, each with its last day as a date and the law it comes from (Consumer Rights Act 2015, Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013), then what the way it was paid adds (section 75, chargeback, PayPal, buy now pay later) and where to go next. Legal information, not legal advice: it never decides a claim.

agreed_delivery_on.description: Not arrived: the delivery day agreed with the seller, YYYY-MM-DD

arrived_on.description: The day it was delivered (goods bought online or at the door), or the day it was marked delivered when it hasn't arrived. Leave out for a shop purchase

bought.description: Online (or by phone or post), in a shop, or at the door or away from a shop

delivery_essential.description: Not arrived: the buyer told the seller the date was essential

exceptions.description: For a change of mind, what may take away the 14 days: personalised, perishable, unsealed-hygiene, unsealed-media (goods); download-started (digital); dated-booking (service)

kind.description: Something physical, a download or app, or a service

left_where_asked.description: Marked delivered: the courier left it with someone or somewhere the buyer chose

nation.description: Where the buyer lives: it sets the time limits and where to go next

ordered_on.description: The day it was bought or ordered, YYYY-MM-DD

paid.description: Credit card, debit card, buy now pay later, PayPal, or cash or another way

price.description: The price of the one item, in pounds

problem.description: What went wrong, by kind: faulty, not-arrived, changed-mind (goods); faulty, changed-mind (digital); poor-service, changed-mind (service). faulty covers not as described
